description: Declarative recipes for COMMAND MIGRATION: move a running command (identified by PID) into an Arker VM, transparently, without CRIU. The mechanism is general — sync the command's working directory + its resumable session state, then re-invoke the command's own resume entrypoint in the VM. It applies to any command that (a) persists its session to an on-disk transcript and (b) can resume from it. Coding agents (Claude Code / Codex / pi / cursor-agent / aider) are the first-class case; the same recipe shape covers any resumable CLI. Loaded identically by the Python, TypeScript, and CLI SDKs, so adding a command is a config entry here, not code in three languages.

recipe_schema.detect: how to recognize the command from /proc/<pid>/cmdline: {argv_contains: str} or {argv_regex: str}
recipe_schema.session: how to find the resumable transcript: {glob: path-with-placeholders, pick: 'newest_mtime', id: 'stem'|'session_path'|{regex: str}}
recipe_schema.install: shell to ensure the command exists in the VM (idempotent)
recipe_schema.place: where to write the transcript in the VM: a path template, or {verbatim_under, from_host_root} to copy a tree verbatim
recipe_schema.extra_files: optional {vm_path: {json: obj}} config files the command needs (e.g. onboarding-accepted)
recipe_schema.env: optional {NAME: value} process env for the resumed command
recipe_schema.resume: shell that resumes the command from the placed transcript; ${probe} is an optional first prompt to verify context carried
recipe_schema.keys: which of the caller's environment API keys to forward (from /proc/<pid>/environ)

placeholders.cwd_key: cwd with every non-alphanumeric char replaced by '-' (commands that key session dirs by project path)
placeholders.session_id: the session identifier extracted per session.id
placeholders.probe: optional first prompt sent to the resumed command to verify state carried

quiesce.note: Before migrating, wait until the transcript stops growing (the in-flight turn has flushed to disk). The ONLY state at risk is the current unflushed turn — completed turns transfer. Optionally SIGSTOP the local command (freeze, so it can't diverge) and SIGTERM it (hand off).

pi.install: node -v | grep -qE 'v(2[0-9]|[3-9])' || (curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - && apt-get install -y nodejs); npm i -g @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent >/dev/null 2>&1
